methods.primaryPivot: minimum D0 RTH M5 low, known prior to D1
methods.secondaryPivot: 20 daily session lows ending D0 adjusted onto D0 as-traded M5 close
methods.confirmation: same or immediately following candle closes >= pivot
methods.entry: next five-minute candle opening price by noon, first qualifying pattern
methods.structuralStop: min breach and confirmation candle lows *0.999; stop distance 0.35%-2.00%
methods.fixedReference: same signal and entry, 2% fixed stop instead of structural constraint
methods.outcomes: D1 through D2 RTH OHLC, open gap first, intrabar stop first on ambiguity, timeout D2 final close
